results.controlIntent: Update the inventory of system components as part of component installations, removals, and system updates.

judgment.rationale:
CM-8(1) requires that the system component inventory be updated as an integral part of installations, removals, and system updates. Evidence from two sources reveals a critical gap:

**Initial Deployment (Acceptable):** The model package (v1) was created on 2025-11-30T18:00:00Z and approved in the registry on 2025-12-01T09:00:00Z (evidence: 79df59a1). The endpoint was then created on 2025-12-01T11:00:00Z (evidence: b40bd2b9) — approximately 2 hours *after* registry approval. This sequence is consistent with proper inventory management: the component was registered and approved before deployment.

**Hotfix Update (Non-Conformant):** A subsequent UpdateEndpoint event occurred on 2026-03-15T14:22:00Z using endpoint config `churn-predictor-v1-hotfix` (evidence: 9be33f5e). No corresponding model registry entry exists for this hotfix version. This means a system component update was deployed without any corresponding inventory update — a direct violation of CM-8(1). The registry only contains version 1 of the model package, with no record of the hotfix change.

The absence of a registry entry for the hotfix deployment means the inventory was not updated as part of that system update, failing the core requirement of this control.
gaps: No registry entry exists for the 'churn-predictor-v1-hotfix' endpoint config — human attestation needed to confirm whether an out-of-band inventory update occurred (e.g., in a CMDB or ticketing system not captured by these tools).
It is unknown whether the hotfix involved a model artifact change or only an infrastructure/config change — this distinction may affect the scope of the inventory requirement.
No evidence of component removals was available; only installations and updates were assessed.

payload.note: Deployed 2h BEFORE registry approval at 09:00 — change control not satisfied
Hotfix deploy — no corresponding registry entry found
